Redwood employment pages in 26D: all 21 pages and profile options

From the 26D update, Oracle turns on the Redwood profile option by default for 21 Oracle Fusion HCM employment pages. You don't need to do anything to get them. If you want to stay on an older page for now, set its profile option to No.

Oracle sources: Oracle 26D What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 26D · Oracle 26C What's New: Redwood Enabled by Default for Employment Pages in Update 26D

Checked against Oracle's pages on 2026-10-19. Oracle can revise its What's New pages; always confirm on the linked Oracle page.

The 21 employment pages and their profile options

Each page has its own profile option, so you can move page by page. "First delivered" is the update in which Oracle released the Redwood version of the page.

How to keep the older pages for now

Oracle lets you switch each page back by setting its profile option to No:

  1. In Setup and Maintenance, open the Manage Administrator Profile Values task.
  2. Search for the profile option code from the table above.
  3. In Profile Values, enter No and save.

Oracle keeps the full list of HCM Redwood profile options in My Oracle Support: HCM Redwood Pages with Profile Options (Doc ID 2922407.1).

What to check before 26D reaches your test pod

  • List which of the 21 pages your HR users and managers use, and run those flows (hire, add assignment, change manager, promote, transfer) on the Redwood pages in your test environment.
  • Decide whether any page needs its profile option set to No for now, and in which pods.
  • Oracle mentions that users can reach these Redwood pages through the quick action for each page.
